summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting, but nothing was run: tests, mypy, and Black were not executed, per your instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the escape formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, using the is_terminal check; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on Windows), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only module). Nothing was committed. Choice made: the terminal check uses is_terminal, matching show_cursor, so on dumb terminals control() drops the buffered title even though the method returns True.
